description: Fetch variation code from a network endpoint and execute it on parents.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: A list of candidate vectors is passed to the reproduction routine.; fitness_evaluation: fitness scores each candidate by summing its genes.; selection: The top eight candidates are used as parents.; mutation: A gene in each dynamically produced child is incremented.; replacement: The selected parents and children are returned as the next pool.. Negative-role rationale: The visible code does not establish two-parent crossover semantics, and no generation-level stop condition exists.
